title: ECG-based Pattern Recognition for Identification of Heart Failure with preserved Ejection Fraction in Individuals with Dyspnea
summary: The creation of a database, through the development and validation of machine learning algorithms that predict the probability of heart failure with preserved LV systolic function (HFpEF) in patients with dyspnea using 12-channel ECG data.
conditions: Left ventricular failure: With symptoms during strenuous activity

interventions.name: After the patient presents to the Chest Pain Unit, an anamnesis is performed regarding the patient's complaints, during which a screening of the patient for the study-specific inclusion and exclusion criteria takes place. criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
• Exertional dyspnea (NYHA ≥ 2)
• Patient age ≥ 18 years
Exclusion criteria:
• Known heart failure
• Pacemaker/ICD with continuous pacing
• Acute coronary syndrome
• Hemodynamic instability and cardiogenic shock
• Lack of capacity to consent
